summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology with hands on experience building autonomous driving and robotics systems in Python and C++. Trained YOLO and lane detection models in CARLA for closed loop autonomous control, and built ROS2 based robotic arm systems validated against MoveIt and RViz kinematic models. Experienced deploying computer vision and multi sensor pipelines, including ToF sensing and vision guided grasping, on NVIDIA Jetson hardware under real world latency constraints.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25 member robotics team across national level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end to end.
Designed and fabricated custom single layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed loop feedback.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Led a cross cultural team of 7 as the sole ML experienced student; took over as team lead mid project to restructure task distribution and deliver a full medical imaging pipeline within a 6 week window.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture recognition glove for hands free cursor control, integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated data generation pipelines using CARLA's semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine tuned UFLD (ResNet-18) with SoftmaxFocalLoss and ParsingRelationLoss; integrated into an adaptive control stack with lane following and waypoint fallback.
Validated in Town02 with 30 vehicles and 10 pedestrians; achieved zero collisions and correct traffic light compliance across multiple laps.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) - MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures across a distributed Flutter, Flask-SocketIO, and Jetson plus Arduino pipeline; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end to end voice to picked latency.
Integrated faster-whisper STT, TensorRT optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup) for visual servoing, and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact aware grasping.
Implemented two link inverse kinematics on Arduino in C++; drove five servos with range gated contact detection.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and hand computed full forward kinematic chains for a 6-DoF UR5e and a 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic.
Planned and executed collision free pick and place trajectories on a physical UR5e via the UR ROS 2 driver; AL5B repeatability measured at under 2mm over 10 trials.
